capabilities: : Aggregate large folders into metadata nodes
extras: Standalone WebGL implementation that does not unregister or replace the built-in graph plugin.
intentEvidence: A standalone alternative to Obsidian's graph view, built to stay responsive in vaults where the built-in view drops to a slideshow.
motivation: The author built it to provide a responsive graph view in large vaults where the built-in view fails.
problem: The built-in graph view becomes unresponsive or unusable in vaults containing a very large number of notes.
summary: A standalone WebGL graph view that maintains responsiveness in large vaults by aggregating folders into single metadata nodes.
